items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, George Lewis's mother can, too. 85 years old. She's about 94 or 5 and could do that. Her eye can.

ctx.x: My mother's 85, and she can pick up the newspaper, sit down there, and go in that room there, and I can't read it in that room like it is there now. And she can read that newspaper in that room there.
Well, George Lewis's mother can, too. 85 years old. She's about 94 or 5 and could do that. Her eye can.
